units.title: SG-4 · Integrate Phaser 3.90 with a lifecycle-safe React host and typed events
Act: Add phaser dependency, createGame factory, game config and PhaserHost
Act: Add the typed event bus module
units.failure: changed tests, which belong to the Verify agent: game/frontend/node_modules/phaser/scripts/tsgen/test/bin/game.js, game/frontend/node_modules/phaser/scripts/tsgen/test/src/game.ts

units.title: Act: Add the Zustand game store, move useGame onto it and add BootScene
Verify: PhaserHost single instance, cleanup, config and resize unit tests

tests.name: tests/phaserHost.test.tsx > keeps a single live game when StrictMode double-invokes the mount effect
tests.title: PhaserHost keeps a single live game when StrictMode double-invokes the mount effect
tests.scenario: Given <React.StrictMode><PhaserHost/></React.StrictMode> with a mocked createGame, when rendered, then two games are created, the first is destroyed with true and the last is not destroyed
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/phaserHost.test.tsx --testTimeout=10000

tests.name: tests/phaserHost.test.tsx > destroys the game exactly once when the host unmounts
tests.title: PhaserHost destroys the game exactly once when the host unmounts
tests.scenario: Given a rendered PhaserHost, when it unmounts, then the game's destroy is called once with true and the ResizeObserver is disconnected
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/phaserHost.test.tsx --testTimeout=10000

tests.name: tests/phaserHost.test.tsx > refreshes the Phaser scale when the container is resized
tests.title: PhaserHost refreshes the Phaser scale when the container is resized
tests.scenario: Given a rendered PhaserHost with a captured ResizeObserver callback, when the callback fires, then scale.refresh is called on the game
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/phaserHost.test.tsx --testTimeout=10000

tests.name: tests/phaserConfig.test.ts > builds a pixel-art config with rounded pixels and FIT scaling
tests.title: Phaser game config builds a pixel-art config with rounded pixels and FIT scaling
tests.scenario: Given buildGameConfig with a div parent and no scenes (phaser mocked), when built, then render.pixelArt and render.roundPixels are true and scale.mode is 3
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/phaserConfig.test.ts --testTimeout=10000

tests.name: tests/phaserConfig.test.ts > computes an integer zoom of at least 1 for a large viewport
tests.title: Phaser game config computes an integer zoom of at least 1 for a large viewport
tests.scenario: Given a 1000x600 viewport at dpr 2, when computeZoom runs, then the result is an integer >= 1
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/phaserConfig.test.ts --testTimeout=10000

tests.name: tests/phaserConfig.test.ts > clamps zoom to 1 for a tiny viewport
tests.title: Phaser game config clamps zoom to 1 for a tiny viewport
tests.scenario: Given a 10x10 viewport at dpr 1, when computeZoom runs, then the result is 1
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/phaserConfig.test.ts --testTimeout=10000

units.title: Verify: Typed event bus delivery unit tests

tests.id: phaserEvents.test.ts > typed event bus delivery > delivers a phaser-to-react event payload to a subscribed handler exactly once
tests.name: delivers a phaser-to-react event payload to a subscribed handler exactly once
tests.title: delivers a phaser-to-react event payload to a subscribed handler exactly once
tests.scenario: Given a handler subscribed to objectClick, When objectClick is emitted with {id:'bookshelf'}, Then the handler is called once with that payload

tests.id: phaserEvents.test.ts > typed event bus delivery > stops delivering events after the returned unsubscribe function is called
tests.name: stops delivering events after the returned unsubscribe function is called
tests.title: stops delivering events after the returned unsubscribe function is called
tests.scenario: Given a handler subscribed and one emit delivered, When unsubscribe is called and objectClick is emitted again, Then the handler is still called only once

tests.id: phaserEvents.test.ts > typed event bus delivery > delivers no events to react-to-phaser handlers after clear is called
tests.name: delivers no events to react-to-phaser handlers after clear is called
tests.title: delivers no events to react-to-phaser handlers after clear is called
tests.scenario: Given a handler subscribed to transitionTo on reactToPhaser, When clear() is called and transitionTo is emitted, Then no handler is called

tests.id: phaserEvents.test.ts > typed event bus delivery > keeps the event bus free of any direct phaser import
tests.name: keeps the event bus free of any direct phaser import
tests.title: keeps the event bus free of any direct phaser import
tests.scenario: Given the src/phaser/events.ts source on disk, Then it does not contain "from 'phaser'"

units.title: Verify: Zustand game store, useGame and BootScene state reading unit tests

tests.name: bootScene.test.ts > readState returns the state currently held by the shared store
tests.title: BootScene readState returns the state currently held by the shared store
tests.scenario: Given the store holds a state, When a BootScene calls readState, Then it returns that same reference

tests.name: bootScene.test.ts > calls onStateChange and returns the new reference when the store state changes after create()
tests.title: BootScene reacts to store changes after create() and reads the new state
tests.scenario: Given create() has run, When the store state is replaced, Then onStateChange is called and readState returns the new reference

tests.name: bootScene.test.ts > stops reacting to store changes after the SHUTDOWN callback runs
tests.title: BootScene stops reacting to store changes after shutdown
tests.scenario: Given create() registered a SHUTDOWN handler, When that handler runs and the store changes, Then onStateChange is not called

tests.name: bootScene.test.ts > emits sceneReady on the phaserToReact bus during create()
tests.title: BootScene emits sceneReady on the phaserToReact bus when created
tests.scenario: Given a listener on phaserToReact, When create() runs, Then it receives sceneReady with sceneId boot

tests.name: gameStore.test.ts > init seeds the state on the first call
tests.title: Game store init seeds the state on the first call
tests.scenario: Given the store is empty, When init is called with a state, Then the store holds that state

tests.name: gameStore.test.ts > a second init does not overwrite the state already set
tests.title: Game store second init does not overwrite existing state
tests.scenario: Given the store is seeded, When init is called again with another state, Then the original state is kept

tests.name: gameStore.test.ts > setState applies the updater to the current state
tests.title: Game store setState applies the updater to the current state
tests.scenario: Given the store is seeded, When setState is called with an updater, Then the updated state reflects the change

tests.name: gameStore.test.ts > setState is a no-op before init
tests.title: Game store setState does nothing before init
tests.scenario: Given the store is empty, When setState is called, Then the state stays null

tests.name: useGame.test.tsx > useGame persistence > persists state across remount
tests.title: useGame keeps persisted state across remount
tests.scenario: Given an action changed state, When the hook remounts, Then the changed state is restored

tests.name: useGame.test.tsx > useGame persistence > storage failure fallback: keeps playing when writes throw and starts fresh on corrupt saves
tests.title: useGame keeps playing when storage fails and starts fresh on corrupt saves
tests.scenario: Given storage reads corrupt data and writes throw, When the hook acts, Then play continues and the action applies
